remarks: Prepare to fall in love with this gracious and elegant colonial! Situated on a picturesque cul-de-sac just ten minutes from Wilton's town center, 6 Robin Lane has been thoughtfully updated with every amenity for today's modern lifestyle. Chef's will delight in the kitchen, complete with marble countertops, 6 burner Wolf range with grill, oversized Sub-Zero refrigerator, double dishwashers, warming drawer, 80-bottle wine fridge, and coffee bar with plumbed Miele espresso machine. The family room features soaring 12' ceilings and a stone fireplace, and flows seamlessly into the formal living room. Rounding out the main level is the large dining room with crystal chandelier, office, mudroom, and two half baths. With ample bedroom space, finished basement, pool, outdoor shower, covered patio, and flat yard, this home is the one you've been waiting for!
